as_told.title: Death of Chris Evans on a West Virginia bridge

plain: A researcher named Chris Evans died on the very day he was due to come and see the Ramseys, according to Scott Ramsey, who tells Michels about it as one of the people Evans was on his way to meet: "He died the day that he was coming to see Susanna." In a second telling Ramsey puts the death in 2005 on a bridge in West Virginia and points to a West Virginia Highway Patrol report on it. Told this way, the timing makes an ordinary death look like something more.
